project_type: PHP native web app with inline JS frontend (Monbis - Monitoring Bisnis BKK Jateng)
build_system: Apache with .htaccess rewrite, no build step needed
verification_instructions: 1. Run php -l on all modified PHP files to verify no syntax errors. 2. Verify JSON response structure matches frontend expectations by tracing API calls.
setup_instructions: No setup needed - PHP files are served directly by Apache
environment_constraints: INTEGRATIONS_ONLY network mode - no external package installation, no Docker. PHP 8.4 available on host. Only AST/syntax validation possible.
contribution_requirements: Follow existing patterns: POST API with type dispatcher, sendResponse() helper, Korwil/Cabang filter pattern, ApexCharts for charts, Tailwind CSS for styling
key_patterns: 1. API routing: POST /api/?request=transaksi with body {type: 'action_name'} dispatches to controller methods. 2. Filter pattern: kode_kantor/korwil/kankas params with Korwil ranges (Semarang 001-007, Solo 008-014, Banyumas 015-021, Pekalongan 022-028). 3. Date pattern: closing_date (M-1 end) + harian_date (actual). 4. Response: {status, message, data}. 5. Frontend: inline <script> in PHP page, fetch to API_URL, ApexCharts for charts. 6. Table: va (transaction table with tgl_transaksi, kode_transaksi, jumlah, kantor, kankas, device, no_rekening, adm, norek_aba). 7. Channel codes: VA='320', Branchless='150','152', QRIS='140','16','162'.
directory_structure: monbis/ root: api/ (backend with controllers/, routes/, helpers/, config/), pages/ (frontend PHP pages), views/ (navbar, header, footer), img/ (assets)
